caption: The drawing features a large, outlined geometric shape resembling a garment—possibly a tunic or robe—centered on a plain, beige background. The outline is composed of fine, black stippled or dotted lines. The upper part of the garment includes a rectangular neck with an angular, stepped neckline and short sleeves or extensions indicated at each side, also marked with stippling. Below the central garment shape, there are two horizontal ornamental bands. The upper band consists of a series of connected, small triangular forms, also rendered in stippled black lines, forming a repetitive pattern. The lower band is wider and has a more intricate design made up of interconnected diamond and zigzag shapes, again using black dots for its outlines and internal patterning. Each element of the drawing is precisely arranged inside a larger, thin, rectangular border that frames the entire composition.
title: Chemise
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
